description: This file defines classes and utility functions for handling HTTP requests asynchronously and synchronously using the httpx library, with custom SSL configuration, request preparation, and error masking. It is part of a larger project related to custom HTTP interactions for a language model API.

classes.name: AsyncHTTPHandler
classes.description: Asynchronous HTTP client wrapper using httpx, managing SSL configurations, request retries, and transport setup.

classes.name: HTTPHandler
classes.description: Synchronous HTTP client wrapper using httpx, supporting request methods with SSL configuration handling and error masking.

classes.name: MaskedHTTPStatusError
classes.description: Custom exception class that masks sensitive information in HTTP errors.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[Union[dict,Mapping]],Any] _prepare_request_data_and_content( data: Optional[Union[dict, str, bytes]] = None, content: Any = None, )
methods.description: Prepares the data and content parameters for httpx requests, routing bytes/str to content and dicts to data, to avoid deprecation warnings.

methods.name: ssl.SSLContext _create_ssl_context( cafile: Optional[str], ssl_security_level: Optional[str], ssl_ecdh_curve: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Creates and configures an SSL context based on provided parameters, with caching to optimize performance.

methods.name: Union[bool,str,ssl.SSLContext] get_ssl_configuration( ssl_verify: Optional[VerifyTypes] = None, )
methods.description: Determines the correct SSL configuration (bool, str, or SSLContext) based on environment, parameters, and caches contexts.

methods.name: Union[bool,str,ssl.SSLContext] get_shared_realtime_ssl_context()
methods.description: Lazily creates or retrieves a shared SSL context for real-time websocket clients.

methods.name: mask_sensitive_info(error_message)
methods.description: Redacts API keys from error messages for security.

methods.name: AsyncHTTPHandler.__init__
methods.description: Initializes an asynchronous HTTP client with optional SSL and session sharing.

methods.name: AsyncHTTPHandler.create_client
methods.description: Creates an httpx.AsyncClient with appropriate transport and SSL configuration.

methods.name: AsyncHTTPHandler._create_async_transport
methods.description: Creates the transport layer, optionally using AiohttpTransport or async httpx transport.

methods.name: AsyncHTTPHandler._should_use_aiohttp_transport
methods.description: Determines whether to use AiohttpTransport based on environment variables and settings.

methods.name: AsyncHTTPHandler._get_ssl_connector_kwargs
methods.description: Provides SSL connector argument configuration for aiohttp TCPConnector.

methods.name: AsyncHTTPHandler._create_aiohttp_transport
methods.description: Creates an AiohttpTransport with SSL context and shared session management.

methods.name: AsyncHTTPHandler._create_httpx_transport
methods.description: Creates a default httpx AsyncHTTPTransport, possibly with local address for IPv4.

methods.name: HTTPHandler.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a synchronous HTTP client with SSL configuration, optional custom client, and default headers.

methods.name: HTTPHandler.get
methods.description: Performs a GET request, with query params extracted from URL.

methods.name: HTTPHandler.extract_query_params
methods.description: Parses query string params from a full URL into a dictionary.

methods.name: HTTPHandler.post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with prepared data, handling timeouts, errors, and streaming.

methods.name: HTTPHandler.patch
methods.description: Performs a PATCH request with prepared data, handling errors uniformly.

methods.name: HTTPHandler.put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with prepared data.

methods.name: HTTPHandler.delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request with prepared data and error handling.
